feature.label: AfterGit Merge Resolver: Languages
feature.description: Syntax colours (TextMate grammars of Eclipse) and the errors of the language servers of Eclipse (lsp4e) for other languages in the AfterGit merge resolver. Needs the Eclipse TextMate support (tm4e) and the Language Server Protocol client (lsp4e).
